title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Strawberry Kiwi Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Strawberry Kiwi brings together the sweetness of ripe Strawberries with the tangy, tropical edge of Kiwi. This bright, fruity mix delivers a clean, refreshing vape with subtle depth and a smooth finish. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod contains a prefilled 2ml pod connected to a 10ml integrated refill reservoir, for 12ml total of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. There’s no refilling or coil swapping required—simply attach it to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. The dual mesh coil supports consistent vapour and flavour clarity for up to 6000 puffs (approx.), providing a smooth MTL experience. Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
